summary: Frontend-only read-only render check on /admin after admin-dashboard-v2 refactor (commit d2912ba). Admin logged in via POST /api/auth/admin/login (200) and JWT stored in localStorage 'rn-admin-jwt' plus 'rn-launch-notice-dismissed'='1'. /admin loaded without blank screen or error boundary; the new AdminWorkspace renders with header 'Admin workspace' and 7 tabs (Control centre, Content, Organisations, Accuracy, Messages, Claims, Advanced). All 7 tabs were clicked in sequence and each swapped in the corresponding section (CONTROL CENTRE, CONTENT 'Manage everything quickly', ORGANISATION ACCESS, ACCURACY & CREDIBILITY, MESSAGES & EMAIL, ORGANISATION ACCESS (Claims), Advanced tools). No React pageerror / crash. Two non-fatal console errors observed (see below). PASS overall for render-only requirement.

integration_issues.issue: React hydration/validation warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Emitted from legacy Admin.jsx around line 4574 inside <select><option>{label}</option></select> where the label expression is wrapped in a span. Non-fatal but pollutes console and will crash server-side hydration if ever SSR'd. Occurs on initial /admin load because the legacy Admin is mounted inside AdminWorkspace's Advanced section.
One resource returned HTTP 500 during /admin load (source URL not surfaced by console). Page still renders. Likely a stats/data endpoint. Please check backend logs for the exact route.

issues: Tab buttons lack data-testid attributes (e.g. admin-tab-content, admin-tab-organisations). Present dashboard section has data-testid='admin-control-centre-v2' but individual tab triggers do not, forcing tests to rely on innerText matching which collides with header 'For organisations' menu.

action_items: Fix legacy Admin.jsx ~line 4574: remove the <span> wrapper inside <option> (option must contain only text). This is inherited legacy code but is now surfaced by the new dashboard because AdminWorkspace mounts it in the Advanced tab.
Investigate the single 500 response emitted on /admin load (source URL suppressed in console — check backend logs for a failing admin stats/metrics call).
Add data-testid to the 7 admin workspace tab triggers (e.g. admin-tab-control-centre / -content / -organisations / -accuracy / -messages / -claims / -advanced) for reliable automation.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminWorkspace still embeds the full legacy Admin component in the Advanced tab, so all the size/complexity issues of Admin.jsx (>4500 lines) are inherited on every /admin visit; consider lazy-loading Advanced.
Missing data-testid on primary tab triggers reduces testability of the new dashboard.

context_for_next_testing_agent: AdminWorkspace v2 renders and all 7 tabs switch. Next agent should confirm the 500 source (backend logs) and verify the <option><span> hydration warning after fix. Header nav dropdown 'For organisations' collides with the admin tab labelled 'Organisations' when using text-based selectors; use y-position filter (100 < y < 300) or add data-testids.
rca of the issue: Hydration warning RCA: React 18 disallows non-text children inside <option>. In Admin.jsx around line 4574 (ModerationQueueCard status <select>), the option label is rendered as an expression that gets wrapped by a runtime <span style='display:contents'> injector (x-ve-dynamic tooling). Fix by ensuring the option children are pure strings — e.g. <option value='open'>{String(label)}</option> — or unwrap the dynamic instrumentation for <option> children.
